content:
Ken: spun up mini-embed-v3 (fp16 -> int8-per-channel) on staging for a quick multibucket smoke. early numbers look fine overall but cluster purity is down and short-query recall@5 takes a hit. posting short summary.
EmbedBot: eval-30421 finished: mini-embed-v3 | short+long holdout | quant=int8-per-channel | status=complete :white_check_mark:
Ken: summary (holdout 9k queries)
```
Model: mini-embed-v3 (int8-per-channel)
Dataset: mixed-holdout (9k)
Recall@1: 0.618 (fp16 0.626, delta -0.008)
Recall@5: 0.833 (fp16 0.870, delta -0.037)
Recall@10: 0.912 (fp16 0.918, delta -0.006)
Length-binned R@5 delta: <=7:-0.072, 8-25:-0.021, >25:-0.005
Cluster purity (agglomerative): 0.49 -> 0.43
Notes: short-queries suffer most; many false positives are high-lexical-overlap but semantically off.
```
Yara: that's a 7.2% R@5 drop for <=7 tokens, too big. Did you run with the same normalization pipeline?
Ken: yes, same post-L2 normalize. command: `python eval.py --model mini-embed-v3 --quant int8-per-channel --dataset mixed-holdout --normalize --nprobe 12`
Leo: try client-side renorm at retrieval as a quick mitigation and run per-tensor baseline. sometimes per-channel helps but per-tensor surprises too.
Ken: kicking per-tensor and client-renorm runs now. also running a 1k calib-rescale (per-channel recalib) per Yara's suggestion.
EmbedBot: quick diffs: top1-cos mean fp16 0.77 int8 0.64; nn-dist median gap 0.11.
OpsBot: perf note: int8-per-channel adds ~2ms median latency on a2s nodes, p95 +6ms vs fp16.
Yara: if recalib recovers >50% of the short-query delta, add a gating rule to onboarding: require length-binned check for <=7 tokens.
Ken: will post recalib numbers in ~12m. also adding ENG-ML-2099 to track hybrid final-proj fp16 experiment.
Leo: small experiment idea: keep last projection in fp16 (hybrid) and quantize others; often recovers ranking without big perf hit.
Ken: queued hybrid run now.
EmbedBot: queued jobs count=3 (per-tensor, recalib-1k, hybrid-final-fp16).
Yara: thanks — keep updates here and attach umap + nn-hist plots to the ticket. :+1:
